title: Figma Bearer header placeholders and public identifiers
summary: Bare Bearer prose, a scheme-only header, placeholders, references, masked values, and a public file key, user id and client id.
rationale: The word Bearer names a scheme and is also an everyday term, so prose or a header with no value is not a credential, and a placeholder, reference or masked display carries no value. A client id, file key and user id are public identifiers that appear beside tokens.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder, reference or public identifier is not a value is a project decision, not a Figma statement.

sources.supports: The API token must be included in an Authorization header using Bearer when calling any of the SCIM methods.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
